integrity: The primary PDF was inspected at the removable-vertex definition, the finite axiom scheme, the planar obstruction, and the higher-genus construction. The local neighborhood argument was reconstructed independently. The supporting Tent--Mohammadi PDF was inspected at its axiomatization and removable-vertex definition, and the surface-edge inequality was checked against standard Euler-characteristic notes.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a lower bound for the orientable genus of finite graphs satisfying the finite Farey axiom package. It does not prove optimality, does not give a matching upper bound, and does not classify nonorientable embeddings.
title: A quadratic genus barrier for finite Farey approximants
